final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS r FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.arcref, s1.fundflux, s1.r, s1.r - s2.a AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.a ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
